# 一呼 · Yihu

> Source-release native iOS browser shell for your own HTTPS Agent workbench. 原生 iOS 语音交互浏览器壳，需自有工作台、模型与签名；不是多人对讲、外贸数据服务或已发布 App Store 成品。

Canonical site: https://getyihu.com/
Source: https://github.com/alexlee2046/yihu-ios
Full bilingual content: https://getyihu.com/llms-full.txt
Privacy: https://getyihu.com/privacy/ | https://getyihu.com/en/privacy/

## Reading contract / 阅读边界

This reference covers seven existing bilingual page families (home, start, privacy, voice drafts, mobile decisions, recording notes, multi-project Radar/Watch) plus eight bilingual selection, preflight, troubleshooting, editorial-review and data-contract guides. Every listed URL has its own canonical and language counterpart. Text is a content reference, not device, latency, radio range, delivery, indexing, AI citation or legal certification. 一共十五类双语页面；源码实现、构建与机器可读文件不等于真机、写入、推送或收录验收。

## Topic routing / 意图与真实能力

- Bluetooth headset / 蓝牙耳机免提预检: /guides/outdoor-store-voice-preflight/ and its /en/ counterpart describe safely stationary input/output checks. Audio-session configuration requests voiceChat/allowBluetoothHFP; pairing is not microphone selection, headset compatibility, headset-button trigger or continuous intercom certification. 安全静止时核对输入，不承诺骑行风噪或多人免按键通话。
- Offline and weak connectivity / 离线与弱网: /start/ and /privacy/ separate prepared local transcription, local notes, existing cached snapshots, model downloads and remote HTTPS handoff. No blanket offline guarantee. 蓝牙、转写完成与远端送达是不同状态；旧缓存不代表本次读取成功。
- Apple Watch / AirPods: /guides/multi-project-radar-watch/ covers paired-phone summaries and phone handoff, not independent approval/refresh. Headset routing checks belong to the preflight guide; no AirPods model is certified by this content. 手腕摘要不是独立对讲或服务写授权。
- AI meeting recording / AI会议录音纪要: /guides/recording-notes-handoff/ explains local audio, segmented transcription, review and one explicit handoff. Transcription is not verified meeting minutes, speaker diarization or automatic action extraction. 原文与副本、暂存与上传、填入与发送分别核对。
- Foreign-trade Radar / 外贸雷达JSON解读: /guides/multi-project-radar-watch/ and /guides/mobile-agent-decisions/ explain authorized user-provided tasks/decisions JSON, source dates, filters and bounded cache. No customs database, market-data subscription, lead scraping or automatic email. 仅自有询盘/跟进台账的通用任务解读，不新增外贸数据产品。
- Radio and voice group chat comparison / 对讲机与语音群聊选型: /guides/voice-workbench-vs-radio-chat/ compares different destinations and prerequisites without invented range/latency. Select independently validated equipment/services for person-to-person live dispatch. 一呼的工作台草稿不是群组语音频道。
- FAQ / 常见问题: visible answers in all guides distinguish source availability, models/signing, host refusal, retained original text, phone confirmation, server authority and receipts. No App Store URL is invented. 重要动作先核对目标；不确定结果先停止，不盲目重试或绕过权限。

## Complete page text / 逐页完整正文

### 一呼 Yihu · 工作台，随身带走。

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/

工作台， 随身带走。 离开桌面，也能用语音接续你的 Agent 工作。 体验一呼 获取源码 场景与界面示意 iPhone 如何接续自有 Agent 工作台？ 一呼（Yihu）是针对 Agent 工作台优化的原生 iOS 浏览器壳：访问自有 HTTPS 网页，在手机上转写语音草稿、保留录音笔记、筛选 PM Radar 事项，并通过系统分享暂存内容。Apple Watch 可接收配对手机摘要。它不提供 Agent 后端；语音需另下载模型，原生增强取决于服务兼容性，源码合入不等于所有真机路径验收通过。 熟悉的工作台，多一层原生体验。 端侧语音 / 录音笔记 / 系统分享 从一句话， 到一份草稿。 亲手试一次：播放一段示例，校对文字，再把它填入工作台草稿。 交互演示 示例内容 · 无需麦克风 0 1 听见 0 2 校对 0 3 填入 把想法，说出来。 校对并编辑转写文字 播放示例 我的工作台 示例 草稿 校对后的文字，会出现在这里。 发送之前，由你确认。 启用 JavaScript 即可体验。实际 App 会将语音转写为草稿，由你检查后决定发送。 让想法，离工作更近一点。 端侧语音 想法刚出现，就说下来。 在 iPhone 上将语音转成可编辑的文字，检查后再交给工作台。语音模型需单独下载。 录音笔记 长一点的想法，也装得下。 先记录，再由手机分段转写。音频和文字留在本地，随时回来整理。 系统分享 看到的，也能带回来。 把文字、链接和文件暂存进分享收件箱，再选择交给工作台的内容。不会自动发送。 系统听写、备忘录还是原生工作台草稿？对照使用边界。 查看手机待决策、来源时效与确认回执边界。 工作台是你的， 节奏也是。 连接你自己信任的 HTTPS 工作台。一呼在它周围，补上 iPhone 的原生能力。 Collie、OpenClaw、Hermes 等网页工作台均可作为访问对象；网页能打开，与原生增强已适配，是两件事。 通知与实时活动需要兼容服务。一呼不托管 Agent，也不提供后端。 了解使用条件 能力与前提核对表 左右滑动表格，查看完整使用前提。键盘用户可聚焦表格后使用方向键。 能力 可以做什么 前提与边界 端侧语音草稿 在手机上转写，再显式填入兼容草稿；不替你发送。 兼容模型另下载，需麦克风权限；宿主拒绝或未知编辑器可能无法填入。 长录音分段转写 保存本地音频和转写文字，供后续整理。 需兼容模型与麦克风权限；录音余项待真机验证，不承诺准确率。 PM Radar 待办筛选 按工作台筛选事项，区分来源读取时间与离线缓存。 自备 JSON 导出或兼容 HTTPS JSON 源；不复用网页 Cookie；回复需独立授权、手机确认与回执。 Apple Watch 摘要 接收配对手机的待决策/待验收摘要，并接续到手机。 需 watchOS 11+ 与配对手机；不是独立审批或手表直写，真机余项待验。 系统分享收件箱 文字、链接和文件先暂存，用户选择后再交接。 不自动上传或发送；目标服务的数据处理规则仍适用。 常见问题 如何在 iPhone 上访问自己的 Agent 网页工作台？ 一呼是围绕 WebKit 的原生 iOS 浏览器壳，可访问手机可达、TLS 证书受信任的自有 HTTPS 工作台。Collie、OpenClaw、Hermes 是网页访问示例，并非原生兼容认证清单；一呼不托管 Agent，也不是它们的官方客户端。 手机接入自建 Agent 工作台之前要准备什么？ 需要 iOS 18+、自有可信 HTTPS 工作台，以及当前源码发行所需的 Mac、Xcode、XcodeGen 和自己的签名配置。使用语音还需单独下载兼容模型并授予麦克风权限。工作台登录和页面兼容取决于服务端。 iPhone 如何把语音转成 Agent 工作台草稿而不自动发送？ 一呼用另下载的 Qwen3 ASR 模型在手机端转写，用户核对后可填入兼容草稿。填入遵守宿主明确拒绝，不向未知编辑器强行写入，也不会按下发送；不兼容时可保留文字供显式复制。 iPhone 能把较长录音分段转写并保留本地笔记吗？ 一呼源码提供长录音、手机分段转写和本地音频/文字保存，需麦克风权限与兼容模型。录音相关真机余项仍待验，不承诺任意时长、设备性能或转写准确率。 如何在手机上筛选多个 Agent 项目的待决策和待验收事项？ 一呼 PM Radar 接收自备 JSON 导出或兼容 HTTPS JSON 数据源，提供工作台独立筛选、管理计数和有界离线快照。来源读取时间用于区分旧缓存与新数据；读取本身不改变台账状态。认证源当前需文件导出，不复用网页 Cookie 或存储凭据。 从手机回复项目决策会自动改任务状态吗？ 不会。一呼仅对符合条件的决策/验收事项，在服务端独立授权、手机明确确认后回复并核验回执；不自动改状态、执行任务、合并或部署。真实回复仍有独立设备/服务验收要求。 Apple Watch 能查看 Agent 项目摘要并独立审批吗？ 手表伴侣通过配对手机接收待决策/待验收摘要，并可把所选事项或受保护草稿接续到手机；需 watchOS 11+。它不提供独立审批或手表直写，手机仍需确认，真机配对等余项待验。 iOS 分享到工作台时会自动上传文件或发送消息吗？ 一呼分享扩展只把文字、链接和文件暂存到 App Group 收件箱，不自动上传或发送。后续交接由用户另行选择，目标工作台的数据处理规则仍适用。 端侧语音识别是否意味着工作台 App 的所有数据都不出手机？ 不是。兼容模型下载后在手机转写，录音笔记本地保存；但模型下载、网页访问、用户发送/上传与可选通知/中继涉及相应服务。端侧转写不能作为所有数据永不出手机的承诺。 能打开 Agent 网页就代表原生推送和实时活动可用吗？ 不代表。原生通知需要兼容网页桥、服务端接口与匹配签名环境的 APNs 配置；实时活动还需自有兼容中继。占位中继地址不可用，推送交付仍需独立验收，台账 GET 数据源本身不是推送事件源。 这类自建工作台 iPhone 客户端现在如何安装？ 一呼当前提供源码，不提供 App Store 安装成品。请按仓库构建说明配置自己的标识、App Group 和签名，再构建到自己的 iPhone；不提供预配置服务器或模型文件。 手机端声纹过滤能替代账号身份认证或写入授权吗？ 不能。一呼声纹验证只是可能误判的便利过滤，不是身份认证；兼容 WeSpeaker/CAM++ 模型未随仓库提供，缺模型时依赖验证的路径不可用，也不能绕过验证或服务端写入授权。 使用条件与构建指南 隐私与数据边界 工作台、对讲机与语音群聊选型 户外与门店：音频预检和文字交接 蓝牙输入分层排障 离线与弱网交接排障 可核对纪要与简报字段 网页朗读与麦克风切换边界 多段笔记汇总与待办核对 Radar JSON类型与空值核对 把工作台，带在身边。 开源，为 iPhone 而做，连接你自己的服务。 开始使用 目前提供源码，需 iOS 18+、自有工作台、语音模型和签名配置。

### Yihu · Your workbench. Within reach.

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/

Your workbench. Within reach. Step away from your desk. Keep your Agent work moving with your voice. Try Yihu Get the source Illustrative scene and interface How can an iPhone connect to your own Agent workbench? Yihu is a native iOS browser shell optimized for Agent workbenches: open your own HTTPS web UI, transcribe speech drafts on the phone, retain voice notes, filter PM Radar items and stage content through system sharing. Apple Watch can receive paired-phone summaries. Yihu supplies no Agent backend; speech needs separately downloaded models and native enhancements depend on service compatibility. Merged source does not certify every device path. Your familiar workbench. A native touch. On-device speech / Voice notes / Sharing A thought. Then a draft. Try the handoff. Play a short sample, edit the words, then place them in a workbench draft. INTERACTIVE DEMO Sample content · no microphone access 0 1 Listen 0 2 Review 0 3 Insert A thought, out loud. Review and edit the transcript Play sample My workbench Demo Draft Your reviewed words will appear here. You decide what to send, and when. Enable JavaScript to try the demo. Yihu transcribes speech into a draft for you to review before sending. Less distance between you and your work. On-device speech Say it while it’s fresh. Turn spoken ideas into an editable draft on your iPhone. Review your words before sending. Speech models are downloaded separately. Voice notes Give a longer thought room. Record now, transcribe in segments on your phone, and return to your audio and text later. System sharing Keep what you find. Bring text, links and files into the share inbox. Choose what to hand off to your workbench. Nothing is sent automatically. Dictation, Notes or native workbench drafts? Compare the boundaries. Read mobile decisions, source freshness and phone confirmation boundaries. Your workbench. Still yours. Connect your own trusted HTTPS workbench. Yihu adds native iPhone capabilities around it. Collie, OpenClaw and Hermes are examples of web workbenches you can open. Page access and native integration are separate capabilities. Notifications and Live Activities require a compatible service. Yihu does not host Agents or provide a backend. See what you need Capabilities and prerequisites Swipe the table to compare prerequisites. With a keyboard, focus the table and use the arrow keys. Capability What it does Prerequisites and boundaries On-device speech drafts Transcribe on the phone and explicitly insert into a compatible draft; never presses Send. Download compatible models and grant microphone access; host refusal or unknown editors can prevent insertion. Segmented voice notes Retain local audio and transcripts for later review. Requires compatible models and microphone access; remaining recording paths need device acceptance, with no accuracy guarantee. PM Radar task filters Filter tasks per workbench and distinguish source-read time from offline cache. Supply a JSON export or compatible HTTPS JSON feed; web cookies are not reused. Replies need separate authorization, phone confirmation and receipt readback. Apple Watch summaries Receive pending decision/acceptance summaries from the paired phone and hand off to it. Requires watchOS 11+ and a paired phone; no standalone approval or direct Watch writes. Remaining device checks are pending. System share inbox Stage text, links and files before a user-selected handoff. No automatic upload or send; the destination service's data practices still apply. Frequently asked questions How can I access my own Agent web workbench on an iPhone? Yihu is a native iOS browser shell around WebKit for your own reachable, trusted HTTPS workbench. Collie, OpenClaw and Hermes are web-access examples, not a certified native compatibility list. Yihu does not host Agents and is not their official client. What do I need before connecting a phone to a self-hosted Agent workbench? You need iOS 18+, your own trusted HTTPS workbench and, for the current source release, a Mac, Xcode, XcodeGen and your own signing setup. Speech also requires separately downloaded compatible models and microphone permission. Login and page compatibility depend on the server. How can an iPhone turn speech into an Agent workbench draft without sending it? Yihu transcribes on the phone with separately downloaded Qwen3 ASR models. After review, text can be inserted into a compatible draft. Insertion respects explicit host refusal, does not force text into unknown editors and never presses Send. Incompatible pages retain text for explicit copying. Can an iPhone transcribe longer recordings in segments and keep local notes? Yihu source includes longer recordings, segmented phone transcription and local audio/text retention, requiring microphone permission and compatible models. Remaining recording-related device checks are pending; no arbitrary duration, device performance or transcription accuracy is guaranteed. How can I filter pending decisions and acceptance items across Agent projects on a phone? Yihu PM Radar accepts your own JSON export or compatible HTTPS JSON feed, with per-workbench filters, management counts and bounded offline snapshots. Source-read times distinguish cached from fresh data; reads do not change ledger status. Authenticated feeds currently require a file export; Radar does not reuse web cookies or store credentials. Does replying to a project decision from a phone automatically change task status? No. For eligible decision/acceptance items, Yihu requires separately authorized server writes and explicit phone confirmation, followed by receipt readback. It does not automatically change status, execute tasks, merge or deploy. Real replies still require separate device/service acceptance. Can an Apple Watch show Agent project summaries and approve them independently? The watchOS 11+ companion receives pending decision/acceptance summaries through the paired phone and can hand off selected items or protected drafts to it. It does not provide standalone approval or direct Watch writes; the phone still requires confirmation and remaining pairing/device checks are pending. Does sharing to a workbench on iOS automatically upload files or send messages? Yihu's share extension stages text, links and files in an App Group inbox. It does not automatically upload or send them. Handoff requires a separate user action, and the destination workbench's data practices still apply. Does on-device speech recognition mean all workbench app data stays on the phone? No. Compatible downloaded models transcribe on the phone and voice notes are stored locally, but model downloads, web access, user sends/uploads and optional notification/relay integrations involve their respective services. On-device transcription is not a promise that all data stays on the phone. Does opening an Agent web page mean native push and Live Activities will work? No. Native notifications need a compatible web bridge, server endpoints and APNs configuration matching the signing environment. Live Activities also need a compatible relay you control. The placeholder relay is unusable, delivery needs separate acceptance and a ledger GET feed is not itself a push event source. How can I currently install this type of self-hosted workbench iPhone client? Yihu currently provides source code, not an App Store binary. Follow the repository build guide to configure your own identifiers, App Group and signing, then build for your iPhone. No preconfigured server or model files are supplied. Can phone speaker verification replace account authentication or write authorization? No. Yihu speaker verification is a convenience filter that can misidentify speakers, not authentication. Compatible WeSpeaker/CAM++ artifacts are not included; verification-dependent paths are unavailable without them. Verification and server write authorization must not be bypassed. Requirements and build guide Privacy and data boundaries Voice workbench, radio or group chat? Outdoor/store audio checks and text handoff Bluetooth input troubleshooting Offline and weak-network handoff Reviewable minutes and brief fields Web read-aloud and microphone transitions Multiple-note review and candidate to-dos Radar JSON types and null checks Take your workbench with you. Open source. Built for iPhone. Connect your own services. Get started Currently a source release. Requires iOS 18+, your own workbench, speech models and signing setup.

Remaining device checks are pending.</td></tr><tr id="capability-sharing" data-astro-cid-4knpj4by><th scope="row" data-astro-cid-4knpj4by>System share inbox</th><td data-astro-cid-4knpj4by>Stage text, links and files before a user-selected handoff.</td><td data-astro-cid-4knpj4by>No automatic upload or send; the destination service&#39;s data practices still apply.</td></tr></tbody></table>

### iPhone Agent 工作台接入与语音草稿 · 一呼 Yihu

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/start/

在 iPhone 接入你的 Agent 工作台 一呼目前提供源码，不是 App Store 安装成品。先完成自有 HTTPS 工作台、源码签名和模型预检，再用一条合成文字验证“确认目标 → 转写与草稿交付 → 核对未发送草稿”；本指南到草稿为止，不发送消息或执行任务。 接入前：六项预检 先构建，再连接 首次语音草稿：合成数据走读 失败分流：只停受影响步骤 接入前：六项预检 左右滑动表格可查看全部列；键盘用户可聚焦表格后使用方向键。 接入前：六项预检 检查与操作 成功信号 失败去向 只填自有 HTTPS origin，例如 https://workbench.example.com；不带账号密码、路径、查询参数或片段。示例域名不能当成可用服务器。 你有自己可用的 HTTPS 源地址，而不是带 /chat?mode=1#draft 的完整页面链接。 地址格式不符 → 地址分流；不要把访问令牌或密码放入网址。 在同一台 iPhone 的 Safari 打开你自己的地址，检查可达性、TLS 和已有登录。手机上的 localhost 指手机本身，不是电脑。 手机能访问预期服务且没有证书警告；登录后看到自己的工作台。Safari 成功只是网络/页面预检，不证明原生增强已兼容。 无法访问、TLS 警告或登录失败 → 网络与权限分流；不关闭证书校验，不为此开放公网端口。 准备 iOS 18+ iPhone，以及带 Xcode、iOS 18+ SDK、Swift 6、XcodeGen 的 Mac。按仓库构建说明配置自己的 Team、Bundle ID 和共享 App Group。 用自己的签名构建并在目标 iPhone 打开一呼。此项需要你实际验证；网页演示或源码合入不是安装证明。 构建/签名错误 → 构建分流；不复制别人签名、凭据或配置，不把签名材料提交到仓库。 在 App 中单独下载兼容的 Qwen3 ASR 模型并等待校验；使用语音需要存储、带宽、适用设备与麦克风权限。 实际版本的模型状态显示可用、录音入口可用；此处先不录音，完成目标与合成内容检查后再按下方走读操作。 模型缺失、校验/权限失败 → 模型分流；不跳过哈希校验，不绕过声纹验证要求。 先确认目标工作台、页面与最后聚焦的可编辑草稿框；确认它不会把输入自动当成提交。不要选终端、发送中界面或未知编辑器。 目标明确、草稿可编辑且应用允许填入；转写后仍需用户检查与单独发送。 宿主拒绝或目标不明 → 草稿分流；不强行写入，不通过改宿主绕过拒绝。 只用合成内容和获准的空白草稿练习，不触碰已有真实任务、私有台账、录音或顾客数据。 你能区分官网静态演示、App 本机转写、工作台草稿及最终发送这几个阶段。 无法确认目标是否会执行或是否含真实数据 → 停在本地笔记，不继续填入。 源地址示例，不是连接测试 正确的输入形态是下面的 origin；网页深层路径不是配置入口。源地址能通过格式检查，也不等于服务器可达或原生功能兼容。 https://workbench.example.com 不要填：https://workbench.example.com/chat?mode=1#draft 先构建，再连接 获取源码，按 README 的 Build locally 配置 project.yml：YIHU_BUNDLE_ID、YIHU_APP_GROUP 与 DEVELOPMENT_TEAM 使用你自己的值；主 App 和分享扩展使用同一 App Group。 按仓库步骤运行 XcodeGen，打开 Yihu.xcodeproj，选 CollieiOS scheme 与自己的设备完成签名构建。推送及相关会员/服务配置是独立前提；不要为了第一份草稿新购服务或配置中继。 打开一呼，输入你自己的可信 HTTPS origin，并按服务端规则登录或配对。不要把其他系统的 Android/SSH 配对说明当成一呼安装步骤。 查看当前版本完整构建说明 首次语音草稿：合成数据走读 合成语句: 整理一份示例读书清单，仅保留草稿，不发送或执行。 流程示意，不是一次已通过的真机测试；官网演示不访问麦克风、不连接你的服务。App 短语音转写后可能自动尝试安全填入，不应假定一定还有二次填入按钮；自动填入不等于自动发送。 预检通过 → 确认工作台/页面/空白草稿框 ↓ 主动录音 → 手机转写 → 守卫下的草稿交付（可能自动） ├─ 已填入 → 核对文字、目标和未发送状态 → 停止 └─ 拒绝/不明 → 保留转写 → 复制到受控本地笔记 → 停止 任一步失败 → 下方故障分流；不盲目重复填入或发送 左右滑动表格可查看全部列；键盘用户可聚焦表格后使用方向键。 首次语音草稿：合成数据走读 步骤与操作 成功信号 不满足时 1. 确认目的地 在你获准使用的工作台打开空白草稿，最后聚焦目标编辑框；记录你要填入的工作台和页面。 目的地明确、没有正在发送/执行的任务；编辑器已确认可保留草稿。 目标不明就停在本地笔记；不要跨页面或跨工作台盲目重试。 2. 主动录音并转写 授予所需麦克风权限，用上面的合成语句作短录音。转写结束后，App 可能自动尝试安全填入；先看草稿与原生面板，不要假定还要再点一次填入。 能在草稿或原生面板核对文字；不保证准确率、任意时长或设备性能。填入不是发送。 按模型/麦克风分流处理，不绕过缺失模型或验证要求。 3. 检查草稿或保留的文字 若已自动填入，只核对文字与目标，不要再次填入。若文字保留在面板，先核对目的地；只有宿主允许且实际界面提供明确手动入口时才选择填入，不把明确拒绝当成再次尝试的理由。 文字位于预期的未发送草稿，或安全保留在面板；没有按下发送。宿主明确拒绝后不降级绕过。 拒绝或不兼容时保留转写，按草稿分流处理；不要为了测试点击发送。 4. 在草稿处停止 只检查合成文字、目标与未发送状态，不触发 Agent。若结果不确定，先核对目的地。 走读结束在未发送草稿或受控本地笔记；不把成功转写当成任务已执行。 不确定时不要盲目再次填入；保留原文，按实际界面处理。 失败分流：只停受影响步骤 地址格式不通过 从自己的服务信息取 HTTPS origin，移除路径、查询参数与片段；不要移除认证边界来“让它通过”。只有示例网址、没有自己的服务时先停；一呼不提供预配置服务器。 手机打不开、TLS 或登录失败 先区分电脑能开与手机能开，检查你已有且获准的网络/私网路径、服务在线状态和证书信任。交由服务维护者修复登录或证书；不忽略安全警告，不公开私有台账，不自行新增隧道、端口或权限。 构建或签名失败 回到当前版本 README 的构建前提，核对 Xcode/SDK、scheme、自有标识、Team 与 App Group。原维护者确认具体错误后再继续；不要上传签名材料或照抄别人开发者配置。 模型、录音或校验失败 按实际 App 提示检查模型下载完整性、设备空间/兼容性和麦克风权限；下载需要网络。不以关闭校验、强行替换模型或跳过声纹验证来恢复。可以先停在文字/本地笔记路径。 宿主拒绝、编辑器未知或填入结果不确定 保留原生面板里的转写，不自动改走其他编辑器，不改宿主绕过明确拒绝。可显式复制到你控制的本地笔记；只有确认另一目标允许草稿且不会自动提交，才考虑手动粘贴，否则停止。结果不确定先查目的地，不盲目再次填入。 接入成功后，仍要分开的能力 HTTPS 页面能打开，不代表任意工作台原生增强兼容；Collie、OpenClaw、Hermes 仅是网页工作台示例，一呼不是它们的官方客户端，不托管 Agent 或提供后端。 端侧转写和本地笔记不等于所有数据不出手机：模型下载、网页访问、用户交接/上传及可选中继涉及相应服务。请先读隐私说明。 PM Radar 需要自备 JSON 导出或兼容数据源；通知、实时活动与 Watch 还有独立服务、配对/授权和设备验收要求。它们不是第一份语音草稿已通过的附带承诺。 隐私与数据边界 · 返回能力与前提核对表 对照系统听写、备忘录与原生工作台草稿边界 查看手机待决策、来源时效与确认回执边界 从源码构建

vertical-align:top; overflow-wrap:anywhere; text-align:start; font-weight:400;"><strong>3. 检查草稿或保留的文字</strong><br>若已自动填入，只核对文字与目标，不要再次填入。若文字保留在面板，先核对目的地；只有宿主允许且实际界面提供明确手动入口时才选择填入，不把明确拒绝当成再次尝试的理由。</th><td style="padding:20px 16px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); vertical-align:top; overflow-wrap:anywhere; text-align:start; font-weight:400;">文字位于预期的未发送草稿，或安全保留在面板；没有按下发送。宿主明确拒绝后不降级绕过。</td><td style="padding:20px 16px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); vertical-align:top; overflow-wrap:anywhere; text-align:start; font-weight:400;">拒绝或不兼容时保留转写，按草稿分流处理；不要为了测试点击发送。</td></tr><tr id="draft-step-4"><th scope="row" style="padding:20px 16px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); vertical-align:top; overflow-wrap:anywhere; text-align:start; font-weight:400;"><strong>4. 在草稿处停止</strong><br>只检查合成文字、目标与未发送状态，不触发 Agent。若结果不确定，先核对目的地。</th><td style="padding:20px 16px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); vertical-align:top; overflow-wrap:anywhere; text-align:start; font-weight:400;">走读结束在未发送草稿或受控本地笔记；不把成功转写当成任务已执行。</td><td style="padding:20px 16px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); vertical-align:top; overflow-wrap:anywhere; text-align:start; font-weight:400;">不确定时不要盲目再次填入；保留原文，按实际界面处理。</td></tr></tbody></table>

Build/signing error → build troubleshooting. Do not copy someone else's signing, credentials or configuration, or commit signing materials. The target is clear, its draft is editable and the app permits insertion. Review and a separate user send remain necessary. Host refusal or unclear target → draft troubleshooting. Do not force insertion or modify the host to bypass refusal. Practice only with synthetic content and an authorized empty draft, not real tasks, private ledgers, recordings or customer data. You can distinguish the website demo, phone transcription, workbench draft and final send. Push and any membership/service setup are separate prerequisites; do not buy a service or configure a relay just to try the first draft. Troubleshooting: stop only the affected step Origin format rejected Use the HTTPS origin from your own service details, without a path, query or fragment. Do not remove authentication boundaries to make it pass. If you only have the example URL and no service, stop; Yihu provides no preconfigured server. Phone cannot connect, TLS or login fails Distinguish access from your computer from access on the phone. Check your existing authorized network/private route, service availability and certificate trust. Ask the service maintainer to fix login or certificates; do not ignore warnings, publish private ledger data, or add tunnels, ports or permissions yourself. Build or signing fails Return to the current README and check Xcode/SDK, scheme, your own identifiers, Team and App Group. Continue after the maintainer identifies the error; never upload signing material or copy another developer's configuration. Model, recording or verification fails Use the app's actual messages to check download completeness, device space/compatibility and microphone permission. Downloads need network access. Do not disable verification, force replacement models or bypass speaker checks. You can stop at a text/local-note path. Host refuses, editor is unknown or insertion is uncertain Keep the transcript in the native panel. Do not automatically switch editors or modify the host to bypass explicit refusal. You may explicitly copy to a local note you control. Consider manual pasting elsewhere only after confirming that target permits drafts and does not auto-submit; otherwise stop. Inspect the destination before repeating an uncertain insertion. Capabilities that remain separate after connecting Opening HTTPS does not certify native enhancements for arbitrary workbenches. Collie, OpenClaw and Hermes are web UI examples; Yihu is not their official client, does not host Agents and supplies no backend. On-device transcription and local notes do not mean all data stays on the phone: model downloads, web access, user handoffs/uploads and optional relays involve their respective services. Read the privacy explanation first. PM Radar requires your own JSON export or compatible feed. ### 数据流与声纹权限边界 · 一呼 Yihu

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/privacy/

每阶段的数据，去了哪里？ 端侧语音只说明识别发生的位置，不代表整个 App 永不联网。这份说明区分官网演示、手机本地处理、网页工作台及可选通知服务，依据当前公开源码与 README；不是完整设备、备份或第三方服务隐私审计。 先区分官网演示与 iPhone App 逐阶段数据流对照表 声纹不是身份认证或写入授权 先区分官网演示与 iPhone App 官网演示播放随站点提供的合成语音，不请求麦克风、不连接你的工作台、不发送消息。编辑文字和演示草稿只存在当前页面的 React 状态中，刷新后不保留。 官网生产环境默认加载 Google Analytics 4（GA4）并采用区域 Consent Mode v2：EEA 30 国（AT、BE、BG、CY、CZ、DE、DK、EE、ES、FI、FR、GR、HR、HU、IE、IS、IT、LI、LT、LU、LV、MT、NL、NO、PL、PT、RO、SE、SI、SK）及英国 GB、瑞士 CH、巴西 BR、日本 JP 默认 analytics_storage=denied，其他地区默认 granted，由 Google 按区域规则应用，不按浏览器语言判断。ad_storage、ad_user_data、ad_personalization 始终 denied。区域默认拒绝不等于零网络：Google 标签仍可能发送无 Cookie ping 及访问/设备相关信息。浏览器持久保存显式允许或拒绝，在页面配置事件前恢复并覆盖区域默认；可在页脚「统计偏好」更改或撤回。显式拒绝/撤回优先禁用此浏览器后续 GA 采集、更新同意状态并清除本站可访问的 GA Cookie，但标签文件仍可请求；已发请求与 Google 已收到的数据不会撤回。存储不可用时当前页仍尊重拒绝并显示保存失败；后续页面可能恢复原保存偏好，需重新选择。初始页面统计使用固定规范网址，不发送查询参数、片段或来源网址；预览环境不加载标签。关闭 Google signals 和广告个性化，不将演示草稿正文作为事件发送。托管平台仍可能处理请求日志。这不是法律合规认证、Google 实收或真实区域流量验收。 逐阶段数据流对照表 左右滑动可查看完整表格；键盘用户可聚焦表格后用方向键阅读。 逐阶段数据流对照表 阶段 / 数据 手机侧发生什么 何时涉及外部服务 不能据此承诺 1. 模型下载 Qwen3 ASR 模型需单独下载到手机；当前模型存储代码检查固定版本、文件大小与 SHA-256。 下载从 Hugging Face 或 ModelScope 发起网络请求，需要带宽与空间，服务方可处理相应请求。 下载模型不等于上传录音；模型可本地运行也不代表安装和所有功能都无需网络。不要跳过校验。 2. 手机端侧转写 兼容模型在手机处理语音。短语音结束后可能自动尝试守卫下的草稿填入；被拒绝或结果不明确时可保留文字。 一旦文字交给网页工作台，就进入对应服务的数据边界；不能把整条交接链统称为离线。 端侧识别不是全 App 不联网的证明，也没有在这里承诺准确率、任意录音时长或所有设备性能。 3. 本地录音笔记 录音笔记在 App 本地保存音频与转写；当前代码为笔记目录尝试设置系统备份排除标记。 用户之后的复制、分享或工作台交接会产生新的数据去向，不能用原笔记的本地保存替它们担保。 源码设置备份排除不等于已经核验某台设备的备份或清除结果；不承诺所有副本都只在此手机、或已永久删除。 4. 网页工作台与草稿交接 WebKit 打开用户自己的 HTTPS 来源；当前网页数据存储是持久化的，可保留该来源的网页数据。语音文字可交给兼容草稿框。 网页加载、登录、草稿处理及用户发送/上传由对应服务参与；其脚本可能保存或同步已收到的草稿。 一呼不替你按发送，不等于网页在发送前不处理数据。HTTPS 和网页能打开，也不等于服务已获得所有原生增强或相同隐私规则。 5. 系统分享收件箱 文字、链接和文件先存到 App Group 收件箱，主 App 与分享扩展共享这份暂存；暂存本身不自动发送。 用户选择交接后，文字可进入网页草稿，文件通过页面的附件/上传入口交给服务；上传时机和后续处理取决于工作台。 暂存、交接、附件上传与消息发送不是同一个步骤。消息未发送不能证明附件未上传；不把 App Group 误称为云服务或绝对加密承诺。 6. 可选中继、通知与实时活动 通知功能还需系统授权、兼容网页桥/服务端接口与匹配签名环境的 APNs 配置；实时活动可依赖自有兼容中继。 启用兼容路径时，注册所需的设备/通知标识及活动更新会涉及相应服务与 APNs；APNs 私钥应由服务端保管。 默认中继是不可用占位地址，不会自动创建服务。能浏览网页不证明推送已送达，也不把可选通知注册描述为纯本地处理。 声纹不是身份认证或写入授权 声纹匹配是可能误判的便利过滤，不是账号身份认证。当前源码将登记特征保存在本地，并设置文件保护与备份排除；这不是对设备备份或防攻击能力的验收证明。兼容 WeSpeaker/CAM++ 模型未随仓库提供，缺失时依赖它们的验证路径不可用，不应关闭验证来绕过缺失模型。 左右滑动可查看完整表格；键盘用户可聚焦表格后用方向键阅读。 声纹不是身份认证或写入授权 层面 由什么决定 不代表什么 声纹便利过滤 本地登记特征与兼容模型提供匹配判断。 不证明账号归属、当前操作意愿、活体检测、防重放或写入权限；不能把“匹配”当成身份认证。 工作台身份认证 你自己的工作台处理登录、配对和会话权限，具体机制以该服务为准。 一呼能打开页面或填入草稿不表示已获得其他账号、设备或资源的权限。 写入与确认 服务端决定目标与操作是否允许；PM Radar 决策/验收回复还需独立写入授权、手机明确确认与回执核验。 声纹通过不授权写入；读台账不自动改状态，不自动执行任务、合并或部署。 使用前，按目的地核对 先核对工作台来源和草稿目标；短语音可能自动尝试填入，录音前就应确认目的地。宿主明确拒绝后不降级绕过，结果不确定先查目标，不盲目再次填入。 复制到本地笔记或其他 App 后，是新的数据副本与处理边界；核对其同步/备份规则。不要在截图、日志或公开反馈中放服务地址、账号/设备标识、录音、私有任务正文或签名材料。 本说明没有替第三方承诺数据保留期、司法地区、删除保证或合规认证；请检查你实际版本、服务配置、系统备份及目标服务政策。录音、推送和 Watch 余项仍沿原设备/服务验收，不由这张表补成已通过。 查看当前实现与接入前提 源码与能力限制 · 安全说明 · 接入预检与首次草稿 对照系统听写、备忘录与原生工作台草稿边界 查看手机待决策、来源时效与确认回执边界

### Data flow and privacy boundaries · Yihu

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/privacy/

Where data goes at each stage On-device speech describes where recognition happens, not an app that never uses the network. This explanation separates the website demo, phone-local processing, web workbenches and optional notification services using current public source and README evidence. It is not a complete device, backup or third-party privacy audit. Separate the website demo from the iPhone app Data flow, stage by stage Speaker verification is not authentication or write authorization Separate the website demo from the iPhone app The website demo plays a synthetic sample served with the site. It does not request microphone access, connect to your workbench or send a message. Edited text and its demo draft live only in the current page's React state and are not retained after reload. The production website loads Google Analytics 4 (GA4) by default using regional Consent Mode v2. analytics_storage defaults to denied in the 30 EEA countries (AT, BE, BG, CY, CZ, DE, DK, EE, ES, FI, FR, GR, HR, HU, IE, IS, IT, LI, LT, LU, LV, MT, NL, NO, PL, PT, RO, SE, SI, SK), plus the UK (GB), Switzerland (CH), Brazil (BR) and Japan (JP); it defaults to granted elsewhere. Google applies these regional rules, not browser-language detection. ad_storage, ad_user_data and ad_personalization always remain denied. Regional denial is not zero network: the tag can send cookieless pings and visit/device-related information. This browser persists explicit allow or decline choices and restores them before page configuration events, overriding regional defaults. Change or withdraw your choice using Analytics preferences in the footer. Explicit decline/withdrawal disables future GA collection in this browser, updates consent and clears accessible GA cookies, but the tag file can still be requested; in-flight requests and data already received by Google cannot be recalled. If saving is unavailable, this page still honors refusal and shows a save-failure warning; later pages may restore a previous saved preference and require a new choice. Initial page measurement uses a fixed canonical URL without query, fragment or referrer. Previews do not load the tag. Google signals and ad personalization are disabled, and demo draft text is not sent as events. Hosting providers may still process request logs. This is not legal certification, proof of Google receipt or real-region traffic acceptance. Data flow, stage by stage Swipe to read the full table. Keyboard users can focus the table and use the arrow keys. Data flow, stage by stage Stage / data On the phone When external services are involved What this does not promise 1. Model downloads Qwen3 ASR models are downloaded separately to the phone. Current model-store code checks pinned revisions, file sizes and SHA-256 hashes. Downloads make network requests to Hugging Face or ModelScope, requiring bandwidth and storage; the provider can process the corresponding requests. Downloading models is not uploading recordings. Local inference does not make installation or every feature network-free. Do not skip verification. 2. On-device transcription Compatible models process speech on the phone. Short-speech completion may automatically attempt guarded draft insertion; refused or uncertain delivery can retain text. Once text is handed to a web workbench, it crosses the service boundary in the next relevant row; the whole handoff is not an offline operation. On-device recognition does not prove the entire app makes no network requests. No accuracy, arbitrary recording-duration or all-device performance guarantee is made here. 3. Local voice notes Voice notes retain audio and transcripts in app-local storage. Current code attempts to mark the notes directory as excluded from system backups. Later copying, sharing or workbench handoffs create new destinations; local retention of the original note does not guarantee how those copies are handled. Setting backup-exclusion flags in source is not verification of a particular device's backups or erasure. It does not promise every copy stays on that phone or has been permanently deleted. 4. Web workbench and draft handoff WebKit opens your own HTTPS origin. Its current website data store is persistent and can retain that origin's website data. Speech text can be handed to a compatible draft editor. Page loads, login, draft handling and user sends/uploads involve the corresponding service; its scripts may save or sync drafts they receive. Yihu not pressing Send does not mean the page cannot process data beforehand. HTTPS access also does not certify native enhancements or uniform privacy practices. 5. System share inbox Text, links and files are staged in an App Group inbox shared by the app and share extension. Staging itself does not automatically send them. After a user-selected handoff, text can enter a web draft and files can be handed to the page's attachment/upload control. Upload timing and subsequent handling depend on the workbench. Staging, handoff, attachment upload and message submission are distinct. An unsent message does not prove no file was uploaded. App Group is not a cloud service or a blanket encryption guarantee. 6. Optional relay, notifications and Live Activities Notifications also need system permission, a compatible web bridge/server and APNs configuration matching the signing environment. Live Activities may depend on a compatible relay you control. Enabled compatible paths involve the service and APNs for registration-related device/notification identifiers and activity updates. APNs private keys belong on the server. The default relay is an unusable placeholder, not an automatically provisioned service. Browsing does not prove push delivery, and optional notification registration is not purely local processing. Speaker verification is not authentication or write authorization Speaker matching is a convenience filter that can misidentify people, not account authentication. Current source stores enrolled features locally and sets file protection and backup exclusion; that is not device-backup or attack-resistance acceptance evidence. Compatible WeSpeaker/CAM++ artifacts are not included in the repository. Verification-dependent paths are unavailable without them; do not disable verification to bypass missing models. Swipe to read the full table. Keyboard users can focus the table and use the arrow keys. Speaker verification is not authentication or write authorization Layer What determines it What it does not establish Speaker convenience filter Local enrolled features and compatible models provide a matching decision. It does not establish account ownership, current intent, liveness, replay resistance or write permission. A match is not authentication. Workbench authentication Your own workbench handles login, pairing and session permissions under its particular implementation. Opening a page or inserting a draft does not grant access to other accounts, devices or resources. Writes and confirmation The server authorizes the target and operation. PM Radar decision/acceptance replies also need separate write authorization, explicit phone confirmation and receipt readback. A voice match does not authorize a write. Reading the ledger does not automatically change status, execute tasks, merge or deploy. Check each destination before use Confirm the workbench origin and draft target before recording because short speech may automatically attempt insertion. Explicit host refusal never falls through to a bypass. Inspect the target after uncertainty instead of blindly inserting again. Copying into a local note or another app creates another copy and handling boundary; check its sync/backup settings. Do not put service origins, account/device identifiers, recordings, private task text or signing materials in public screenshots, logs or feedback. This explanation does not promise third-party retention periods, processing jurisdictions, guaranteed deletion or compliance certification. Check your actual app version, service configuration, system backups and destination policy. Remaining recording, push and Watch acceptance is not established by this table. Inspect the current implementation and setup prerequisites Source and limitations · Security guidance · Connection checks and first draft Compare Dictation, Notes and native workbench drafts Read mobile decisions, source freshness and phone confirmation boundaries

### iPhone 系统听写、备忘录与原生工作台草稿对照 · 一呼 Yihu

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/iphone-agent-voice-drafts/

iPhone 语音草稿：系统听写、备忘录，还是一呼？ 先按任务选择，而不是按“语音 App”标签选择：已在可信输入框内可先用系统听写；还没确定工作台时先在备忘录整理；需要接续自有 Agent 网页工作台时，再评估一呼的原生转写与草稿守卫。下面只比较有官方资料或一呼源码依据的边界，不比较未测准确率、时长、速度或 Watch 独立审批。 先选一条符合当前任务的路径 三条路径的事实对照 一份合成转写走读：只到未发送草稿 依据与下一步 先选一条符合当前任务的路径 已有可信、可编辑且不会自动提交的工作台输入框：系统键盘听写可以减少切换；先确认宿主的草稿保存/提交规则，不把键盘输入当成工作台兼容认证。 想先整理一句话、尚未选择 Agent 目的地：用系统听写输入到备忘录，再手动选择后续交接。先核对笔记账户和同步策略，不把备忘录一概叫作纯本地存储。 已有自有 HTTPS 工作台，并希望用原生端侧模型与带目标检查的草稿交付：可评估一呼。当前是源码发行，需自备服务、签名和模型；它不托管 Agent，也不是通用工作台兼容承诺。 三条路径的事实对照 左右滑动查看全部列；键盘用户可聚焦表格后使用方向键。 三条路径的事实对照 核对维度 系统键盘听写 → 输入框 系统听写 → 备忘录 → 手动交接 一呼原生语音 → 自有工作台 识别位置 Apple 说明键盘设置会显示是否在设备处理；否则听写内容会发往服务器。不能给所有设备/语言统一贴上“全端侧”标签。[A1][A2] 此处指用键盘听写写入笔记，不是另行评测 Apple 录音转写；识别边界仍按系统听写设置。笔记存在哪个账户另行核对。[A1][A2][A3] 兼容 Qwen3 ASR 模型另下载、校验后在手机转写；下载、网页与后续交接不是离线保证。[Y1] 是否自动送出 官方指南描述在当前文本插入点输入文字；宿主是否自动提交或保存不是键盘指南保证的行为。[A1] 本文手动路径只先写笔记，不调用 Agent 发送；随后复制/分享会产生新副本与接收方规则，其他自动化不在比较内。[A3] 短语音可能自动尝试安全填入，但插入代码不按发送；网页可先保存/同步草稿，不等于文字永不离开手机。[Y2a][Y2] 工作台 / 页面绑定 目标是用户当前选中的文本插入点，不据此推断存在一呼的工作台/请求 ID 守卫。[A1] 笔记账户/笔记不是 Agent 页面绑定；交接前还要重新核对工作台、页面和草稿框。 一呼草稿交付检查受信来源、页面和请求目标；录音笔记显式填入还核对打开记录时捕获的工作台/页面与当前交互状态。[Y2][Y3] 宿主拒绝处理 未核实任意宿主的拒绝/自动提交实现；不要把系统键盘可输入当作所有编辑器都安全。 可先保留笔记，不强迫接入宿主；手动粘贴前确认目标允许草稿且不会自动提交。 明确拒绝或未知响应不降级绕过；安全交付失败时保留转写，先查目标，不盲目重复填入。[Y2] App Group 暂存与上传 系统听写本身不是一呼 App Group 收件箱；输入后的处理由接收 App/网页决定。 只有实际选择分享到一呼才涉及其暂存箱；复制到其他 App 则按该目的地规则处理。 一呼分享收件箱先暂存文字/链接/文件；用户交接后可进入页面草稿或附件入口，消息未发送不证明文件未上传。[Y4] 模型 / 权限前提 按实际系统版本启用听写，核对可用语言和键盘设置中的处理说明；这里不要求安装一呼模型。[A1][A2] 同样核对听写前提，并检查 Notes 账户/同步配置；移除账户不表示互联网账户中的笔记已删除。[A3] iOS 18+、自有可信 HTTPS 工作台、源码构建/自有签名、兼容模型与麦克风权限；缺声纹模型不绕过所需验证。[Y1] “笔记在本地”与“交给工作台”是两件事 Apple 官方资料说明，从 iPhone 移除 Notes 账户后，笔记仍可保留在互联网账户和其他已设置设备；因此先核对所选账户，不用“没点发送”代替同步/备份检查。[A3] 一呼录音笔记源码保存本地音频与转写，并尝试排除系统备份；这不是本轮真机备份、任意长录音或性能验收。显式交接可能产生另一份副本或网页处理边界。[Y3][Y3a] 声纹只是可能误判的便利过滤，不是账号认证或写入授权。通知、实时活动、Watch 及真实回复另有前提；不能从一次草稿交付推断它们已通过。[Y1] 一份合成转写走读：只到未发送草稿 这是文字流程示意，不是一次已经通过的真机测试，也不在本网页调用麦克风或工作台。只选获准的空白草稿/笔记，不使用真实任务或顾客内容。 合成语句: 整理一份示例读书清单，仅保留草稿，不发送或执行。 左右滑动查看全部列；键盘用户可聚焦表格后使用方向键。 一份合成转写走读：只到未发送草稿 步骤 / 操作 成功信号 不满足时 1. 录音前选路径与目的地 先核对服务、页面、可编辑草稿及不自动提交规则；若未确定目的地，先选备忘录并核对账户。选择一呼则先完成接入预检。 目标清楚，或明确先停在受控笔记里；不会碰到已有真实任务。 不知道宿主会不会执行就不录到该输入框；保留本地整理路径。 2. 只采集这条合成语句 系统路径按键盘听写指南输入并停止；一呼路径按当前已允许的录音入口操作，短语音结束后可能自动尝试安全填入。 看到笔记/草稿/原生面板中的文字；不假定一呼必有第二次填入按钮。 权限、模型或宿主拒绝就停在相应边界，不关闭校验/验证来绕过。 3. 核对文字、目标与交接边界 已填入就只检查，不再次填入。笔记手动交接前确认目的地；若选择一呼分享，区分 App Group 暂存、附件交接与消息发送。 文字位于预期未发送草稿，或安全保留在笔记/面板；没有为演示按发送。 结果不确定先查目标；拒绝后不换编辑器强塞，不盲目重试。 4. 在草稿处结束 检查后停止；不调用 Agent，不触发上传测试或真实回复，不用这条走读证明性能与其他功能。 走读终点是未发送草稿或受控笔记，不是已执行任务。 如目的地已产生同步/附件处理，按该服务实际规则核对，不宣称所有副本都已删除。 这份比较没有证明什么 不是三套产品的等价功能认证或性能榜单；Apple 列来自官方说明，一呼列来自当前源码/README。系统版本、语言、账户、编辑器与服务配置仍需实际核对。 不承诺任意长录音、转写准确率、速度、续航、推送交付或 Watch 独立审批。已合入源码、官网演示和静态构建都不能替代真机/服务验收。 App 不按发送不等于网页不处理草稿；端侧转写不等于所有数据都不出手机。不要绕过证书、声纹、权限或明确宿主拒绝。 依据与下一步 [A1] Apple · Dictate text on iPhone [A2] Apple · Siri, Dictation & Privacy [A3] Apple · Notes accounts [Y1] Yihu README · source release, models and limitations [Y2] Yihu · guarded short-speech delivery and insertion [Y2a] Yihu · automatic guarded short-speech delivery [Y3] Yihu · captured voice-note destination [Y3a] Yihu · local voice-note storage and backup-exclusion attempt [Y4] Yihu · explicit share handoff 接入预检与首次草稿 · 逐阶段数据流与声纹边界 · 返回能力概览 查看手机待决策、来源时效与确认回执边界 录音笔记：分段转写与显式交接

### iPhone voice drafts: Dictation, Notes or Yihu?

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/iphone-agent-voice-drafts/

iPhone voice drafts: Dictation, Notes or Yihu? Choose by task, not by the label “voice app”: use keyboard Dictation in a trusted editor, collect thoughts in Notes before choosing an Agent destination, or evaluate Yihu's native transcription and guarded draft handoff for your own web workbench. This compares documented boundaries, not untested accuracy, duration, speed or standalone Watch approval. Choose a path for the task in front of you Documented boundaries across three paths One synthetic walkthrough: stop at an unsent draft Evidence and next steps Choose a path for the task in front of you Already in a trusted, editable workbench field that does not auto-submit: keyboard Dictation may avoid a separate handoff. Confirm the host's draft/submission rules; keyboard input is not workbench compatibility certification. Capturing a thought before choosing an Agent destination: dictate into Notes, then explicitly choose a later handoff. Check the note account and sync policy; Notes is not automatically local-only storage. Already own a trusted HTTPS workbench and want native local models plus target-checked draft delivery: evaluate Yihu. It is a source release requiring your service, signing and models; it does not host Agents or certify arbitrary workbench compatibility. Documented boundaries across three paths Swipe to read all columns. Keyboard users can focus the table and use the arrow keys. Documented boundaries across three paths Dimension Keyboard Dictation → editor Dictation → Notes → manual handoff Yihu native speech → your workbench Recognition location Apple says Keyboard Settings indicates on-device processing; otherwise dictated content is sent to a server. Do not label every device/language fully on-device. [A1][A2] This path means keyboard Dictation into a note, not a separate review of Apple's recording transcription. Recognition follows Dictation settings; check the note account separately. [A1][A2][A3] Compatible Qwen3 ASR models run on the phone after separate download and verification. Downloads, browsing and later handoff are not offline guarantees. [Y1] Automatic submission Apple documents text entry at the selected insertion point. It does not guarantee whether a host automatically submits or saves that text. [A1] This manual path first writes a note without calling an Agent send action. Later copy/share creates new copies and destination rules; other automations are outside this comparison. [A3] Short speech may automatically attempt guarded insertion, but insertion code does not press Send. A page can save/sync drafts before message submission. [Y2a][Y2] Workbench / page binding The target is the user's selected text insertion point; that does not establish Yihu-style workbench/request-ID guards. [A1] A note/account is not a binding to an Agent page. Recheck the workbench, page and draft editor before handoff. Yihu checks trusted origin, page and request targets. Explicit voice-note insertion also checks the workbench/page captured when opening notes and the current interaction state. [Y2][Y3] Host refusal Arbitrary host refusal and auto-submit behavior is unverified. Keyboard editability alone does not make every editor safe. Retain the note rather than forcing host integration. Paste only after confirming the destination permits drafts and does not auto-submit. Explicit refusal or unknown responses do not fall through to a bypass. Failed safe delivery retains text; inspect the target instead of blindly inserting again. [Y2] App Group staging / upload Keyboard Dictation itself is not Yihu's App Group inbox; the receiving app/page controls subsequent processing. Yihu staging applies only when you actually choose to share into Yihu. Other copy/share destinations have their own rules. Yihu stages text, links and files first. A user handoff can reach a page draft or attachment control; an unsent message does not prove no file was uploaded. [Y4] Models / permissions Enable Dictation for the actual system version and check language availability and processing details in Keyboard Settings. This path does not require Yihu models. [A1][A2] Check Dictation prerequisites and Notes account/sync settings. Removing an account does not erase notes from the internet account. [A3] iOS 18+, your trusted HTTPS workbench, source build/own signing, compatible models and microphone permission. Do not bypass required verification when speaker models are missing. [Y1] Keeping a note and handing it to a workbench are different Apple documents that removing a Notes account from an iPhone can leave notes in the internet account and other configured devices. Check the selected account rather than treating “not sent” as a sync/backup check. [A3] Yihu voice-note source retains local audio/transcripts and attempts backup exclusion. That is not this guide's proof of device backups, arbitrary long recordings or performance. Explicit handoff may create another copy or web-processing boundary. [Y3][Y3a] Speaker matching is a convenience filter that can misidentify people, not account authentication or write authorization. Notifications, Live Activities, Watch and real replies have separate prerequisites; one draft handoff does not certify them. [Y1] One synthetic walkthrough: stop at an unsent draft This is a written process illustration, not a passed device test. This page does not call your microphone or workbench. Use an authorized empty draft/note, never real tasks or customer content. Synthetic phrase: Draft a sample reading list; keep it as a draft, without sending or running it. Swipe to read all columns. Keyboard users can focus the table and use the arrow keys. One synthetic walkthrough: stop at an unsent draft Step / action Success signal Otherwise 1. Choose the path and target before recording Confirm the service, page, editable draft and no-auto-submit rule. If the destination is unclear, choose Notes first and check its account. For Yihu, complete setup checks first. The target is clear, or you intentionally stop in a controlled note without touching existing real tasks. Do not record into an editor with unknown execution behavior; keep the separate capture path. 2. Capture only the synthetic phrase Use keyboard Dictation and stop it for the system path. For Yihu, use the recording entry point currently permitted by your version; short-speech completion may automatically attempt guarded insertion. Text appears in a note, draft or native panel. Do not assume Yihu needs a second insertion click. Stop at permission, model or host-refusal boundaries; do not disable checks or verification to bypass them. 3. Review text, destination and handoff boundaries If already inserted, inspect rather than insert again. Verify the destination before handing off a note. With Yihu sharing, distinguish App Group staging, attachment handoff and message submission. Text is in the intended unsent draft or retained safely in a note/panel. No Send action is used for this illustration. Inspect uncertainty at the destination. Do not force another editor after refusal or retry blindly. 4. End at the draft Stop after inspection. Do not invoke the Agent, test uploads or send real replies, and do not use this walkthrough as performance or feature certification. The endpoint is an unsent draft or controlled note, not an executed task. If the destination already performed sync/attachment processing, follow its actual rules; do not claim every copy was erased. What this comparison does not establish This is not feature-equivalence certification or a performance ranking. Apple columns use official documentation; Yihu columns use current source/README evidence. Check the actual system version, language, account, editor and service configuration. No arbitrary long-recording, transcription-accuracy, speed, battery, push-delivery or independent Watch-approval claim is made. Merged source, website demos and static builds do not replace device/service acceptance. Not pressing Send does not stop a web page processing drafts. On-device transcription is not a promise that all data stays on the phone. Do not bypass certificates, speaker checks, permissions or explicit host refusal. Failed safe delivery retains text; inspect the target instead of blindly inserting again. [Y2]</td></tr><tr id="compare-sharing"><th scope="row">App Group staging / upload</th><td>Keyboard Dictation itself is not Yihu&#39;s App Group inbox; the receiving app/page controls subsequent processing.</td><td>Yihu staging applies only when you actually choose to share into Yihu. Other copy/share destinations have their own rules.</td><td>Yihu stages text, links and files first. A user handoff can reach a page draft or attachment control; an unsent message does not prove no file was uploaded. [Y4]</td></tr><tr id="compare-requirements"><th scope="row">Models / permissions</th><td>Enable Dictation for the actual system version and check language availability and processing details in Keyboard Settings. This path does not require Yihu models. [A1][A2]</td><td>Check Dictation prerequisites and Notes account/sync settings. Removing an account does not erase notes from the internet account. [A3]</td><td>iOS 18+, your trusted HTTPS workbench, source build/own signing, compatible models and microphone permission. Do not bypass required verification when speaker models are missing. [Y1]</td></tr></tbody></table>

<table class="walkthrough-table"><caption>One synthetic walkthrough: stop at an unsent draft</caption><thead><tr><th scope="col">Step / action</th><th scope="col">Success signal</th><th scope="col">Otherwise</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr id="step-destination"><th scope="row"><strong>1. Choose the path and target before recording</strong><br>Confirm the service, page, editable draft and no-auto-submit rule. If the destination is unclear, choose Notes first and check its account. For Yihu, complete setup checks first.</th><td>The target is clear, or you intentionally stop in a controlled note without touching existing real tasks.</td><td>Do not record into an editor with unknown execution behavior; keep the separate capture path.</td></tr><tr id="step-capture"><th scope="row"><strong>2. Capture only the synthetic phrase</strong><br>Use keyboard Dictation and stop it for the system path. Do not assume Yihu needs a second insertion click.</td><td>Stop at permission, model or host-refusal boundaries; do not disable checks or verification to bypass them.</td></tr><tr id="step-review"><th scope="row"><strong>3. ### 手机 Agent 决策、验收与回执边界 · 一呼 Yihu

手机查看 Agent 待决策与待验收：先读，再确认 一呼 PM Radar 从你自己的 JSON 导出或兼容 HTTPS 数据源读取台账，按工作台筛选事项；读到一条任务不代表已经授权回复，更不代表任务已执行。下面用两条合成记录解释筛选、来源时效、手机确认与回执边界；Watch 是配对 iPhone 的伴侣，不是独立审批入口。 最小合成 JSON：不是一个在线服务 同一份样例，筛选前后有什么变化？ 条：demo-acceptance。 等待验收不等于已经通过；手机需要查看证据与下一步。 在本例清除筛选，回到未完成范围 2 条。 来源未改变。项目、优先级、搜索与状态条件相交；其他条件仍有限制时不要把零结果误报为没有任务。 tasks 表示完整任务集合，decisions 表示待决策/待验收子集；当前 Swift 视图的管理计数和状态分组从筛选后的完整任务形成，不把 decisions 当成全量台账。完成/搁置默认隐藏，可通过历史范围查看；缓存年龄或最近 Git 活动都不是任务完成/阻塞的依据。[R1][R7] 来源读取时间，不是手机刚联网的时间 左右滑动查看全部列；键盘用户可聚焦表格后用方向键阅读。 来源读取时间，不是手机刚联网的时间 信号 源码 / README 的语义 不能推断什么 date_str 最后一次成功来源读取的时间；当前模型按 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm、UTC+08:00 解析。样例故意固定该值。 刷新按钮被点过、手机刚下载或命中缓存，都不能把旧来源时间改成新鲜来源。 source_refreshing / source_refresh_failed 区分再验证中与来源读取失败。手机可先显示有界缓存，再用一次 no-cache 跟进同一次读取，不启动轮询循环。 失败时保留旧快照不是刷新成功；不能把没读到的新增事项记成零。 过期 / 未来时钟提示 当前模型把超过 24 小时的数据标为旧数据；超过当前时钟五分钟的未来时点会触发时钟警告。这些是来源时效提示。 旧缓存不代表条目已搁置或阻塞；任务状态必须来自显式字段。 可选只读适配器 README 描述按请求触发的有界内存缓存：30 秒新鲜、来源再验证期间最多使用五分钟旧快照；私网/权限检查仍独立。 [R6] 这些是特定适配器策略，不是所有 JSON 服务的承诺，不是五分钟一定有新业务数据。 Radar 数据源不复用网页 Cookie、不存储数据源凭据或跟随重定向；需要认证的来源当前按 README 用文件导出。它与浏览工作台 origin 的配置不同，不能通过公开端口、移除认证或把密码放进 URL 来解决接入。请沿已有获准的私有访问路径核对。[R2][R5] 只读 → 手机明确确认 → 服务端回执 / 不确定停止 下列是源码/README 描述的可选写路径，不是本例已经可以写入：本例 reply_supported=false，也没有可连接服务。任何实际回复都需要独立服务端授权和符合条件的原条目。 左右滑动查看完整内容；键盘用户可聚焦此区域后用方向键阅读。 读取快照 / 筛选（不写状态） ↓ 原条目是否可回复 + 服务端独立授权？ ├─ 否 → 只读 / 保留草稿 → 停止 └─ 是 → 读取最新目标与版本 → 手机完整核对并明确确认 ↓ 持久保存同一 request_id → 服务端提交 ├─ recorded 回执 → 已记录，待负责人处理（不等于执行/验收通过） └─ 超时 / 不确定 → 冻结输入，查回同一请求；不盲目重发 目标 / 来源变化 → 重新读取并确认；未解决的待核结果不当作从未写入 左右滑动查看全部列；键盘用户可聚焦表格后用方向键阅读。 只读 → 手机明确确认 → 服务端回执 / 不确定停止 阶段 必须成立的条件 停止 / 回读边界 只读 / 草稿 筛选只是读取；未获得服务端独立写权限或目标不符合条件时停在只读。 界面可见、Watch 可见或能读历史，都不授予写权限。 手机明确确认 获取最新标题、链接、状态、下一步及完整回复，再在第二次确认界面由用户确认。 来源或目标版本变化后重新确认；不能把旧缓存目标直接当本次写入凭证。 提交 / 回执 提交前持久保存请求身份，服务端核对授权和目标；recorded 才表明该回复被记录。 记录回复不是改任务状态、执行 Agent、合并或部署；负责人是否处理另需证据。 不确定 / 停止 超时或结果不明时保留待核状态并查回同一请求；丢失回执不等于没有写入。 不生成新请求来盲目重发，不以重启服务器后的查无结果强行当作从未提交。 本指南不提供写入启用命令或真实回复入口，也不替你操作服务。源码中的同一请求/回执保护不是全链路 exactly-once 保证；实际设备、服务与真机回复仍需原验收。[R3][R5][R6] Watch 和通知：把边界放在能力之前 watchOS 11+ 伴侣通过已配对 iPhone 的 WatchConnectivity 接收待决策/待验收摘要；手机桥检查配对和 Watch App 状态。摘要不是任意 Agent 后端直连，也不是完整来源数据或凭据传输。[R4] 所选事项或受保护草稿可以接续到手机；Watch 收到“草稿已保存”类确认，只代表手机安全保留了提案，不等于服务端回复已记录。手机仍要读取最新目标并明确确认，直接手表写入/独立审批仍未授权。[R4] 读取 JSON feed 不是推送事件源。原生通知与系统镜像需要兼容服务、权限及设备条件；现有源码里的通知事件解析不证明上游事件源已获准或推送已送达。不开新通知后端、不加轮询，不把独立 Watch APNs 当作已有能力。[R1][R4][R5] 这份演示没有验收什么 只有合成 JSON、离线模型解码/筛选与静态页面检查；未导入真实设备、未读私有台账、未登录服务、未发回复、未配对 Watch 或注册通知。 读数/筛选、手机已保存草稿、服务端已记录回复、任务已处理/已执行，是不同状态，不互相代替。界面显示和文案不能补成真机回复或推送验收通过。 不提供后台、签名、账号凭据或默认可写源，不承诺完整离线、全链路 exactly-once 或自动运营；使用自己的可信服务并遵守原授权。 源码依据与接续 [R1] Snapshot fields, exact filters, source-time parsing [R2] Bounded feed reads, one revalidation follow-up, cache storage [R3] Phone confirmation, pending request and receipt/readback [R4] Paired-phone Watch summaries and protected draft acknowledgement [R5] README: workbenches, Watch, notifications and reply prerequisites [R6] Optional private read adapter and separately authorized reply path [R7] Current management counts, status groups and clear-filter behavior 接入预检 · 数据流与权限边界 · 语音草稿选择与交接 · 返回能力概览 多项目 Radar：JSON、缓存与 Watch 交接

[R1][R7] Source-read time is not the phone's last download Swipe to read all columns. Keyboard users can focus the table and use the arrow keys. Source-read time is not the phone's last download Signal Source / README meaning What it does not establish date_str The last successful source read. The current model parses yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm in UTC+08:00; this fixture intentionally fixes it. A refresh tap, phone download or cache hit cannot make an old source-read time fresh. source_refreshing / source_refresh_failed Distinguish revalidation from failed source reads. The phone can paint bounded cache and make one no-cache follow-up joining the same read, without a polling loop. Keeping the old snapshot after failure is not successful refresh. Missing new items must not be counted as zero. Stale / future-clock warnings The current model marks data older than 24 hours stale and warns when the source time is more than five minutes ahead. These are source-freshness signals. Old cache does not make a task paused or blocked; task state comes from explicit source fields. Optional read-only adapter The README describes request-triggered bounded memory caching: 30 seconds fresh, at most five minutes old while revalidating. Private access/permission checks remain separate. [R6] These are this adapter's policies, not a guarantee for every JSON service or of new business data every five minutes. Radar feeds do not reuse web cookies, store feed credentials or follow redirects; the README currently directs authenticated feeds to file export. This differs from configuring a browser workbench origin. Do not fix access by exposing public ports, removing authentication or putting passwords in URLs; use the existing authorized private path. [R2][R5] Read-only → explicit phone confirmation → receipt or uncertain-stop This is the optional write path described by source/README, not permission enabled by this fixture: reply_supported=false and no reachable service are provided. Actual replies require separate server authorization and eligible original items. Scroll sideways to read the full content. Keyboard users can focus this block and use the arrow keys. Read snapshot / filter (no status write) ↓ Eligible original target + separate server write authorization? ├─ No → read-only / retain draft → stop └─ Yes → fetch fresh target/version → full phone review + explicit confirmation ↓ persist the same request_id → server submission ├─ recorded receipt → recorded, awaiting owner handling (not execution/acceptance) └─ timeout / uncertainty → freeze input, read back the same request; no blind resend Changed target/source → fresh read and confirmation; unresolved is not proof of no write Swipe to read all columns. Keyboard users can focus the table and use the arrow keys. Read-only → explicit phone confirmation → receipt or uncertain-stop Stage Required condition Stop / readback boundary Read-only / draft Filters only read. Stay read-only without separate server write permission or an eligible target. Visibility, Watch visibility or history-read access do not grant write authority. Explicit phone confirmation Fetch current title, link, status, next step and the complete reply, then let the user confirm in the second confirmation view. Changed source/target versions require new confirmation; an old cached target is not a current write credential. Submit / receipt Persist request identity before submission; the server checks target/authority. Only a recorded receipt establishes the reply was recorded. Recording a reply does not change task status, execute an Agent, merge or deploy; later handling needs separate evidence. Uncertain / stop After timeout or an unclear result, retain pending state and read back the same request. A lost receipt is not proof of no write. Do not generate a new request to resend blindly or treat an absent result after server restart as proof no submission occurred. This guide supplies no write-enabling command or real reply endpoint and does not operate a service. Request/receipt guards are not an end-to-end exactly-once guarantee; actual device/service replies still need their original acceptance. [R3][R5][R6] Watch and notifications: prerequisites before promises The watchOS 11+ companion receives pending decision/acceptance summaries through the paired iPhone's WatchConnectivity. The phone bridge checks pairing and Watch-app installation. This is not arbitrary Agent-backend connectivity or transfer of complete source data/credentials. [R4] Selected items or protected drafts can hand off to the phone. A draft-saved acknowledgement only means the phone retained the proposal, not that a server reply was recorded. Fresh phone target checks and explicit confirmation remain necessary; direct Watch writes/standalone approval are not authorized. [R4] A JSON GET feed is not a push event source. Native notifications and mirroring depend on compatible service, permission and device support. Notification-event parsing code does not prove an authorized upstream event source or delivered push. No new notification backend, polling or independent Watch APNs is enabled here. [R1][R4][R5] What this demonstration has not accepted Only synthetic JSON, offline model decoding/filtering and static page checks are involved. No real device import, private ledger, service login, reply, Watch pairing or notification registration was tested. Read/filter results, a phone-saved draft, a server-recorded reply and a handled/executed task are different states. Displayed content cannot substitute for device reply or push-delivery acceptance. No backend, signing, account credentials or preconfigured writable feed is supplied. There is no promise of full offline behavior, end-to-end exactly-once or autonomous operations; use your trusted services and original authorization gates. Source evidence and next steps [R1] Snapshot fields, exact filters, source-time parsing [R2] Bounded feed reads, one revalidation follow-up, cache storage [R3] Phone confirmation, pending request and receipt/readback [R4] Paired-phone Watch summaries and protected draft acknowledgement [R5] README: workbenches, Watch, notifications and reply prerequisites [R6] Optional private read adapter and separately authorized reply path [R7] Current management counts, status groups and clear-filter behavior Setup checks · Data and permission boundaries · Voice-draft choices and handoff · Back to capabilities Multi-project Radar: JSON, cache age and Watch handoff

### iPhone长录音笔记：分段转写、本地保存与显式交接

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/recording-notes-handoff/

iPhone长录音笔记：分段转写、本地保存与显式交接 首答 一呼把录音笔记留在手机，结束记录后在可用的前台时段分段转写，供你核对，再显式选择填入草稿或暂存文字附件。结束录音不等于交给Agent；填入不等于发送，暂存不等于上传成功。本文解释当前源码路径，没有新增长时录音、锁屏持续性、转写速度或耗电的真机保证。 从记录到交接：五个独立动作 准备 ：使用自有签名的App、可用本地模型与麦克风权限；访问网页还需你可达、证书受信任的自有HTTPS工作台。录音笔记不是云端录音服务，也不是App Store成品保证。 录音 ：开始/结束记录。当前界面描述支持锁屏录音，但本轮未做锁屏、来电中断、空间不足或长时真机测试；不要据此承诺持续时长。 转写与核对 ：结束记录将进入等待/转写路径，不会像短语音输入那样直接尝试交付网页。让App在前台且无冲突时处理；核对人名、数字、否定词与分段接缝。识别文字不是已生成的会议纪要。 显式选择 ：确认打开记录时捕获的工作台/页面。短转写选择草稿填入；长转写选择分享托盘的Markdown附件暂存，再单独处理附件交接。界面还存在有独立资格检查的雷达事项草稿路径，本专题不把它混同网页填入或已发送回复。 检查结果 ：核对草稿或附件及对应目标，再决定后续操作。结果不明确时停止自动动作，保留原文核查后手动复制；不要清除一次交接标记来“再试一次”。 阶段 当前实现/保存位置 不能据此声称 录音 本机audio.caf；麦克风需系统授权 无限时长、永不被系统中断 分段 16kHz帧、最多28秒窗口、末8秒低能量搜索 语义分段、说话人分离、不截词或精度/速度达标 恢复 note.json保存文本、状态与transcribedFrames；异常状态重载为pending 进程被杀仍持续转写、绝对不丢字 直接填入 转写完成、字符门槛、一次预约与捕获页面检查 当前任意页面均可填入、自动发送 托盘暂存 文字或Markdown；不附带原始录音 自动上传、删除本地即撤回服务端 原文保留 不确定结果仍可读/复制 复制绝不重复、对方已收到或已执行 合成走读，不录音 ：设一条已完成的虚构笔记内容为“请整理示例讨论的三个问题，不执行操作”。先核对目标，再选择一种交接动作。3000与3001个ASCII字符用于解释现有门槛，不代表真实录音长度测试；源码使用Swift Character计数，不将UTF-8字节或Unicode标量数混作同一门槛。手动复制也可能制造重复，必须先核对目标。 详细问答 较长的手机录音怎样在端侧分段转写，而不是一次处理整段音频？ 当前分段器按16kHz帧计数读取最多28秒窗口，在窗口末8秒范围寻找低能量切点，最终窗口可整体保留，再拼接识别文字。这是实现策略，不保证不截词、准确率、耗电或任意录音时长；本轮没有长录音真机性能证据。 录音转写中断后，怎样确认保存进度并继续处理？ 记录元数据保存已转写帧位置；重新加载时，遗留的recording/transcribing状态转为pending，在应用前台且满足可转写条件时尝试继续。等待、失败和完成要分开看，核对断点附近文字；这不承诺后台一直转写、自动生成纪要或崩溃绝不丢字。 录音和转写保存在手机本地，是否就没有备份或交接副本？ 录音与元数据位于本机VoiceNotes目录，包含audio.caf与note.json；源码尝试将该目录排除备份，不等于所有设备都已验证排除成功。手动复制、分享托盘或交接给网页会产生其他副本；删除本地笔记不等于删除工作台、剪贴板或服务端副本。 把录音笔记交给网页工作台之前，怎样避免填入错的页面？ 先在目标工作台聚焦草稿输入框，再打开记录并核对页面。显式填入绑定打开记录时捕获的会话与页面，交接前检查连接、当前目标及忙碌状态；切换来源或页面后不要假定目标随之变更。未知编辑器或拒绝结果不绕过，也不自动按Send。 录音转写何时直接填入，何时作为文件暂存到分享托盘？ 当前笔记界面以转写字符数3000为直接填入门槛，且需转写完成、尚未交接并通过目标检查；较长转写沿用Markdown附件暂存路径，分享的是文字而非原始录音。3000不是录音时长或模型上限，存入托盘也不是已上传或已发送；后续附件交接可能先上传到工作台。 录音笔记交接结果不明时，为什么不能自动重试或另存再交？ 每条笔记在显式填入或托盘暂存之前先原子写入一次交接标记。标记写不成就拒绝交接；尝试失败或结果不明时保留原文，但不自动重试或换另一条交接路径。先核对目标已有内容，再决定是否手动复制；标记不等于工作台已收到或Agent已执行。 承接阅读： 开始 · 隐私 · 短语音草稿

### iPhone recording notes: segmented transcription and explicit handoff

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/recording-notes-handoff/

iPhone recording notes: segmented transcription and explicit handoff First answer Yihu keeps recording notes on the phone, transcribes them in segments when foreground processing is available, and lets you review the text before explicitly inserting a draft or staging a text attachment. Stopping a recording is not handing it to an Agent; insertion is not sending, and staging is not a successful upload. This guide describes the current code path, not a new device guarantee for long sessions, lock-screen continuity, speed or battery use. Five separate actions: recording is not handoff Prepare : use your own signed app, available local model and microphone permission. Web access needs your own reachable, trusted HTTPS workbench. Notes are not a hosted recording service or a promise of an App Store binary. Record : explicitly start and stop. The current UI describes lock-screen recording, but this task did not test locked screens, interruptions, low storage or long sessions on a device. No supported duration is inferred. Transcribe and review : stopping moves into pending/transcription, not the automatic delivery attempt used by short dictation. Keep the app foregrounded and free of conflicts. Check names, numbers, negations and segment joins. Recognized text is not automatically generated meeting minutes. Choose explicitly : verify the workbench/page captured when notes opened. Insert eligible short text into a draft, or stage a longer Markdown attachment in the share tray before a separate attachment handoff. An independently gated Radar-item draft path also exists; it is not interchangeable with web insertion or a sent reply. Inspect the result : verify the draft/attachment and destination before any further action. On uncertainty, stop automatic actions and inspect before copying manually. Do not reset the one-handoff marker to force another attempt. Stage Current implementation Does not establish Recording Local audio.caf; system microphone permission Unlimited length or immunity to interruption Segmentation 16 kHz frames; up to 28-second windows; final-eight-second energy search Semantic segmentation, speaker diarization, accuracy or speed Recovery note.json text/state/transcribedFrames; interrupted states reload as pending Continued transcription after process death or lossless recovery Insertion Completion, character threshold, reservation and captured-page checks Insertion into any current page or automatic Send Share tray Text or Markdown, not original audio Automatic upload or remote deletion when a note is deleted Retained original Readable/copyable on uncertainty Duplicate-free copying, receipt or execution Synthetic walkthrough, no recording : use an imaginary completed note saying “Summarize the three demo discussion questions; take no action.” Verify the target, then choose one handoff. ASCII lengths 3000 and 3001 explain the existing boundary, not a recording-duration test. The source uses Swift Character counts; do not substitute UTF-8 bytes or Unicode scalar counts. Even manual copying can duplicate content: check the destination first. Detailed questions and answers How can longer phone recordings be transcribed in on-device segments rather than as one entire clip? The current segmenter counts 16 kHz frames in windows of up to 28 seconds, searches the final eight seconds for a low-energy cut, and may retain the final window whole before joining recognized text. This is an implementation strategy, not a guarantee against split words, an accuracy or battery benchmark, or support for arbitrary recording durations. No long-recording device benchmark was performed here. How should I check saved progress and continue after recording transcription is interrupted? Note metadata stores the transcribed frame position. On reload, leftover recording/transcribing states become pending; processing can continue in the foreground when transcription is allowed. Distinguish pending, failed and done, and review text around the interruption. This does not promise continuous background transcription, automatic minutes or lossless crash recovery. If audio and transcripts are stored locally on my phone, can backups or handoff copies still exist? Audio and metadata live in the phone’s VoiceNotes directory as audio.caf and note.json. The code attempts to exclude that directory from backups; success has not been verified on every device. Copying, share-tray staging and web handoff can create other copies. Deleting a local note does not delete workbench, clipboard or server copies. How can I avoid inserting a recording note into the wrong workbench page? Focus the intended draft composer before opening notes, and verify the page. Explicit insertion is bound to the session and page captured when notes opened, with connection, target and busy-state checks before handoff. Do not assume switching a source or page retargets an open note view. Unknown editors and refusals are not bypassed, and Send is never pressed automatically. When should a recording transcript be inserted directly versus staged as a file in the share tray? The current note UI limits direct insertion to 3,000 transcript characters, with transcription complete, no prior handoff and valid target checks. Longer transcripts use the existing staged Markdown attachment path; the shared content is text, not the raw recording. This is not a duration or model limit. Staging is not uploading or sending, although later attachment handoff may upload to the workbench. Why should an uncertain recording-note handoff not be retried automatically or restaged? Each note atomically reserves one handoff marker before explicit insertion or share-tray staging. If the reservation cannot be written, handoff is refused. A failed or uncertain attempt retains the original text but is not automatically retried or redirected through another handoff path. Inspect the destination before deciding whether to copy manually. The marker is not proof of workbench receipt or Agent execution. Related reading: Get started · Privacy · Short voice drafts

### 多项目PM Radar：JSON结构、缓存时效与Watch到手机交接

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/multi-project-radar-watch/

多项目PM Radar：JSON结构、缓存时效与Watch到手机交接 首答 一呼的PM Radar消费你提供的多项目JSON快照：先分清全任务、待处理子集与来源时间，再交叉筛选。配对Watch提供既有摘要与手机交接，不提供独立台账刷新、审批、推送或执行保证。能读数据不代表能写；缺字段、旧缓存或读取失败必须显式呈现。 从源契约到手腕摘要 选来源 ：导入有权限取得的JSON文件，或配置现有受控HTTPS数据源；不要把私有台账公开，也不要在源地址中塞账号、令牌或参数。原生源读取与网页登录认证不是同一条会话。 核结构 ：确认date_str、decisions、active/stale/cold，以及可选tasks。任务的project与项目记录的path对应。别用一个叫projects的数组替代模型要求的三个项目数组。 看来源时间和失败状态 ：展示旧快照不等于刚刷新成功；source_refreshing与source_refresh_failed须分别呈现。请求发起、缓存命中和源读取成功不能共享一个“最新”标签。 再筛选 ：检查项目/状态/优先级/搜索与历史开关。管理分组/计数按当前View的筛选后全任务集合；README概述不覆盖View行为证据，不能把decisions视为完整台账。 手腕只作速览/交接 ：核对来源日期和手机可达性。同步重发已有快照；打开事项和提案仍需手机校验来源/事项、忙碌状态、独立确认及服务端权限，不直接审批。 数据/层级 含义 常见误读 tasks / decisions 全任务 / 待决策验收子集；旧源缺tasks时标不完整 子集少就表示项目没任务 active / stale / cold 源提供的项目活动记录，path关联任务project stale数组等于快照过期，或Git不活跃等于任务阻塞 源date_str 最后成功读取的UTC+08:00时间 手机点刷新就改成现在 手机离线缓存 上次有效快照；失败时保留并提示 有卡片就表示本次刷新成功 可选适配器缓存 请求触发；30秒新鲜，重验时最多五分钟旧值；无可用值且读取失败可503 全部源都会每30秒刷新、手机端延迟SLA Watch同步 重发手机已有待决策/验收摘要；超限裁剪提示回手机 重新读取台账、queued即页面已打开 写/通知 各自授权、服务端/订阅和设备条件 能GET就能回写/收到推送，Watch是独立审批器 合成走读 ：本地样例有demo-alpha两任务、demo-beta一任务，tasks=3而decisions=1。demo-beta与“等你决策”相交为0，改为该项目实际状态“待做”后为1；不是项目丢失。Watch只筛待决策/验收，所以无beta摘要不等于beta不存在。固定日期2026-10-18 09:00是历史演示数据，不能据当前页面发布时间称其新鲜。样例reply_supported=false、所有链接为example.invalid，不连接真实源或触发写入。 两层时效不要混用 ：客户端以24小时与未来5分钟标记数据/时钟问题；可选适配器的30秒/五分钟是服务器读缓存边界，不代表台账内容更新频率。刷新中的源可先显示缓存并一次no-cache跟进，不新增计时器、调度器或轮询。 详细问答 多项目任务快照怎样区分完整任务集合、待处理子集和项目活动？ 当前JSON使用tasks表达全任务集合、decisions表达待决策/验收子集，active/stale/cold提供项目记录；projects是模型合并这三个数组的计算属性，不是替代导入键。任务project对应项目path。旧导出没有tasks时回退到decisions并提示台账不完整，不能拿子集数量当全任务数；实际管理计数以当前View的筛选后全任务集合为准。 切换多项目工作台的数据源时，怎样防止旧缓存冒充新来源？ 原生JSON读取不复用网页Cookie、不存凭据且不跟随重定向；需认证的源按现有说明使用文件导出，不把密钥拼进地址。改源前需清理旧缓存，清理失败则拒绝变更，未决回复也会阻止换源；来源修订检查丢弃旧请求结果。它不替代服务端访问控制，也不保证任何两个来源的权限相同。 项目、状态和搜索条件相交后没有结果，怎样判断是空台账还是筛选遮蔽？ 项目、源状态、优先级与搜索条件相交；已完成/搁置事项默认隐藏，必要时显示历史并核对筛选。先看是否有tasks，再清除不相关条件、单选目标项目、逐项恢复筛选。零结果不能证明项目完工、被阻塞或来源为空，状态缺失也不靠代码活跃度推断。 怎样区分任务来源时间、缓存命中和手机刚发起的刷新？ date_str是来源最后成功读取时间，按UTC+08:00解释，不能用手机请求时间或缓存命中改写。source_refreshing/source_refresh_failed分别提示后台源读取中或失败；手机保留旧快照，最多一次no-cache后续请求，不建立轮询。超过24小时标旧、来源时钟超前超过5分钟警告；可选服务端适配器的30秒/5分钟缓存是另一层，不是手机刷新SLA。 手表上的项目速览和同步提示，能证明台账已刷新或手机已处理吗？ 配对Watch接收手机既有快照中的待决策/验收摘要，并显示来源时间、读取失败和可达性；同步请求重新传手机已有快照，不触发源台账刷新。queued只代表请求入队，saved只代表手机安全保存提案，不等于页面已打开、回复已提交或任务已处理；最终确认与回执仍在iPhone及授权服务链。 能读取任务JSON和手表摘要，为什么不等于能写回复或收到任务推送？ JSON GET、回复写授权与通知事件源是分开的能力面。可读快照或reply_supported标记不代替服务端身份、目标权限、手机显式确认与回读；源GET也不是推送事件流。通知另需授权上游、设备订阅与匹配签名/系统条件，Watch直写另走独立授权，本候选不声称生产送达或自动改状态。 承接阅读： 开始 · 隐私 · 移动决策流程

### Multi-project PM Radar: JSON, cache age and Watch-to-iPhone handoff

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/multi-project-radar-watch/

Multi-project PM Radar: JSON, cache age and Watch-to-iPhone handoff First answer Yihu PM Radar consumes your multi-project JSON snapshots: distinguish the ledger, pending subset and source time before filtering. A paired Watch offers existing summaries and a phone handoff, not independent ledger refresh, approval, push delivery or execution guarantees. Read access is not write permission; missing fields, stale caches and failed reads must remain visible. From source contract to a wrist summary Choose a source : import an authorized JSON export or configure an existing access-controlled HTTPS feed. Do not publish private ledgers or put credentials, tokens or query parameters in the URL. A native feed read does not share the web login session. Check structure : inspect date_str, decisions, active/stale/cold and optional tasks. A task’s project matches a project record’s path. An array named projects does not replace the three arrays required by the current model. Inspect source time and failure flags : displaying an old snapshot is not a successful refresh. Distinguish source_refreshing from source_refresh_failed. Request initiation, cache hits and successful source reads must not share a misleading “latest” label. Then filter : check project/status/priority/search and history. Current View management groups/counts use the filtered full-task set. The README overview does not override View behavior; decisions is not the complete ledger. Use the wrist for preview/handoff : check source age and phone reachability. Sync republishes an existing snapshot. Opening an item or proposing text still requires phone source/task checks, busy-state guards, explicit confirmation and separate server authority—not independent approval. Data/layer Meaning Misinterpretation to avoid tasks / decisions Ledger / pending subset; missing tasks means incomplete legacy scope A small subset means no project tasks active / stale / cold Source project-activity records; path joins task project The stale bucket is snapshot expiry, or inactivity proves blockage Source date_str Last successful read in UTC+08:00 Pressing refresh makes it current Phone cache Last valid snapshot, retained with a failure indication Visible cards prove a successful new read Optional adapter cache Request-triggered; fresh 30s, old up to 5m while revalidating; failed reads without usable data can return 503 Every source refreshes on a 30s schedule or provides a phone SLA Watch sync Existing pending summaries; truncation points back to the phone A fresh ledger read or queued means the UI opened Writes / notifications Separate authorization, subscription/service and device prerequisites GET implies write/push permission or a standalone Watch approver Synthetic walkthrough : demo-alpha has two tasks and demo-beta one: tasks=3, decisions=1. Intersecting demo-beta with the waiting-for-decision status gives zero; selecting its actual to-do status gives one. The project did not disappear. Watch selects decision/acceptance items only, so no beta summary is not proof that beta is absent. The fixed date 2026-10-18 09:00 is historical demo data, not fresh because this page was published now. reply_supported=false and example.invalid links prevent this illustration from claiming a real source or write. Keep cache layers separate : client warnings use 24 hours and five minutes into the future; the optional adapter’s 30s/5m bounds describe read caching, not task-update frequency. A refreshing source can paint cached data and receive one no-cache follow-up. This introduces no scheduler, timer or polling. Detailed questions and answers How should a multi-project snapshot distinguish the full task ledger, pending items and project activity? The JSON uses tasks for the full ledger, decisions for the decision/acceptance subset, and active/stale/cold for project records. projects is a computed model property combining those three arrays, not a replacement import key. A task’s project matches a project’s path. Legacy exports without tasks fall back to decisions with an incomplete-ledger notice. Do not treat subset counts as ledger totals; current management counts follow the View’s filtered full-task set. How can I prevent an old cached snapshot from masquerading as a new workbench source? Native JSON reads do not reuse web cookies, store credentials or follow redirects. Use the documented file-export path for authenticated feeds rather than embedding a secret in a URL. Changing a source requires clearing its old cache; failure or an unresolved reply can block the change. Source-revision checks discard results from superseded requests. These safeguards do not replace server access control or equate the permissions of different sources. If project, status and search filters return nothing, how can I distinguish an empty ledger from filtered-out tasks? Project, source-status, priority and search filters intersect. Completed and on-hold items are hidden by default; inspect history and filters where needed. Check whether tasks is present, clear unrelated conditions, select the intended project and restore filters one at a time. Zero matches do not establish completion, blockage or an empty source. Missing task status is not inferred from code activity. How do I distinguish source read time, a cache hit and a refresh just requested on my phone? date_str records the last successful source read in UTC+08:00, not a phone request time or a cache hit. source_refreshing/source_refresh_failed signal an in-flight or failed source read. The phone retains its previous snapshot and can make one no-cache follow-up, not a polling loop. Data older than 24 hours is stale; a source clock over five minutes ahead triggers a warning. The optional adapter’s 30-second/five-minute cache is a separate layer, not a phone refresh SLA. Does a watch project summary or sync acknowledgment prove that the ledger refreshed or the phone handled an item? A paired Watch receives pending decision/acceptance summaries from the phone’s existing snapshot, with source age, read failures and reachability. A sync request republishes that snapshot rather than refreshing the source ledger. queued means queued; saved means a proposal was safely persisted on the phone. Neither proves an opened page, a submitted reply or a handled task. Final confirmation and readback still belong to the iPhone and authorized service path. Why does reading task JSON or a watch summary not imply permission to reply or receive task pushes? JSON GET, reply-write authorization and notification event sources are separate capability planes. A readable snapshot or reply_supported flag does not replace server identity, target permissions, explicit phone confirmation and readback. A GET feed is not a push event stream. Notifications need an authorized upstream, device subscription and matching signing/system conditions; direct Watch writes retain a separate authorization gate. This candidate claims neither production delivery nor automatic status changes. Related reading: Get started · Privacy · Mobile decisions

### 一呼、传统对讲机与语音群聊：按交接对象选工具

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/voice-workbench-vs-radio-chat/

一呼、传统对讲机与语音群聊：按交接对象选工具 先看接收方：Agent 草稿不等于人与人对讲 一呼是访问自有 HTTPS Agent 工作台的 iOS 浏览器壳，增加手机端语音转写、录音笔记与 PM Radar JSON 读取。传统对讲机用于符合设备制式与当地规则的无线通话；普通语音群聊用于相应服务里的联系人或群组。若需求是持续的人与人现场调度，不应把一呼当作已经验证的对讲机或语音群聊替代品。下表比较使用边界，不是三种方案的实测排名。 先分清三种交接 对人说话 ：先确认收听人、通信制式或服务、现场权限和备用联络方式。不同对讲机与聊天软件的能力不能一概而论。 把想法交给 Agent ：先选工作台与页面草稿框，再使用已配置模型的手机转写；草稿填入不是消息发送，更不是任务执行。 先保留记录 ：录音笔记保留本地音频和文字，核对后再显式交接。会议记录不自动变成确认无误的纪要或分配给团队的任务。 参数与选型边界对照 核对项 一呼当前范围 传统对讲机 普通语音群聊 接收对象 自有网页工作台的草稿，或本地笔记；不是群组语音频道 兼容设备/系统内的收听方，按具体设备确认 相应聊天服务里的联系人或群组，按实际产品确认 连接条件 网页需手机可达的可信 HTTPS；转写需另下载兼容模型 频段、制式、覆盖与当地使用规则需核实 账号、权限、网络和服务状态需核实 蓝牙与耳机 近场采集源码配置 voiceChat 与 allowBluetoothHFP；不等于任意耳机适配认证 配件接口、协议与麦克风行为看具体型号 输入输出与通话行为看软件、系统和耳机组合 离线/弱网 已备模型的端侧处理、本地笔记和既有 Radar 缓存各有边界；网页交接不保证离线 不据工具类别推断是否依赖中继或网络 不据类别承诺离线收发；检查实际服务 发送与回执 不自动按 Send；Radar 回复另需服务端授权、手机确认及回读 按设备通话操作与现场回读规程，不由本页认证 按实际软件的发送/接收提示，不等同对方已处理 距离与延迟 没有本轮对讲距离、端到端时延或持续通话测试结果 不给出脱离设备、环境和制式的统一数值 不给出脱离网络与服务的统一数值 锁屏与免按键 不承诺锁屏唤醒、持续免按键对讲或耳机按键触发 以具体设备说明和验证为准 以软件版本、系统策略和验证为准 可审阅文字 可核对转写、目标与显式交接；识别可能出错 是否带录音/文字功能以具体设备为准 文字、转写、录音保存规则以实际产品为准 蓝牙音频预检不是免提通话认证 CollieAudioCapturePreferences 的近场模式配置了 playAndRecord 、 voiceChat 和 allowBluetoothHFP ；关闭近场时配置不同。这说明源码会请求相应音频会话，不证明某一款 AirPods、头盔耳机或蓝牙适配器已通过真机验证，也不证明风噪抑制、回声控制或长时续航达标。 在安全静止环境先确认系统输入、输出及录音权限，用一条无真实任务的合成语句检查转写和草稿目标。更换耳机、来电或音频服务重置后重新检查。录音笔记源码有输入设备变化后的重定向和失败提示路径；不能由此保证中断无损恢复。不得在行驶中操作手机或为了测试绕过宿主拒绝。 离线、会议与外贸需求怎样分流 弱网或离线 ：已下载且可用的模型与本地音频不等于网页可访问。缓存卡片只是既有快照，失败或旧来源须显示；不要把点刷新、蓝牙已连接或本地识别完成当作远端已收到。 AI 会议录音纪要 ：一呼提供的是录音、分段转写和保留原文，会议纪要需要另外核对并在获准的目标流程里整理。本页不承诺说话人分离、自动提炼行动项或识别准确率；录音前确认参与者知情和适用规则。 外贸雷达 ：若你的自有台账把询盘或跟进任务导出为符合 PM Radar 契约的 JSON，可按项目与状态阅读；这不是内置海关数据库、市场情报订阅、客户资料搜集或自动发信服务。 tasks 与 decisions 、来源时间、缓存状态以及写授权仍须分别核对。 FAQ 一呼能直接替换门店或车队对讲机吗？ 不能据当前源码这样承诺。它的交接对象是自己的工作台草稿，不是已验收的多人语音频道。现场实时联络应另选符合条件的设备/服务并做当地环境验证；一呼可在安全静止时辅助整理文字记录。 蓝牙耳机已连接，是否代表一呼正在使用耳机麦克风？ 不代表。配对状态、实际输入路由和当前音频会话是不同事实。需要在实际设备上核对输入、输出和合成录音结果；源码选项不替代耳机型号兼容证明。 Apple Watch 能作为独立对讲或审批终端吗？ 当前 Watch 伴侣接收配对手机的既有摘要并接续到手机，需配对及系统条件。它不提供本页承诺的独立对讲、台账刷新或独立审批；手机确认与服务端授权仍独立存在。 没有网络时转写完成，能算已经交付吗？ 不能。识别文字只说明该处理步骤有结果。网页、附件上传或真实回复仍依赖目标服务与权限。结果不确定先保留原文并核对目的地，不自动重试。 外贸团队可以导入询盘任务吗？ 只有在团队有权使用并自行导出符合模型契约的 JSON 时才可按现有 Radar 规则阅读。来源身份、字段、日期与缓存必须明确；本页不新增外贸数据源、客户名单、通知后台或自动跟进。 在哪里下载 App Store 成品？ 当前是源码发行，没有已发布成品链接。请按构建指南使用自己的签名、模型和工作台。本页不会用虚构商店链接或“已上线源码”替代安装与设备验收。 依据与下一步 README：能力、前提与限制 音频会话策略源码 录音输入变化处理源码 户外骑行与门店：静止预检及文字交接指南 · 开始 · 隐私 · 录音笔记 · 多项目 Radar 与 Watch
